etsy.title: Lick the Spoon Poster, Funny Recipe Card Print, Retro Baking Wall Art, Gift for Baker, Kitchen Humor Decor
etsy.description:
A funny recipe card poster with the only steps that matter: 2 cups flour, don't overmix, bake at 350, and lick the spoon. Retro diner-style kitchen art for bakers who know the best part.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a kitchen, bakery corner, or dining room.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Several Etsy sellers offer 'lick the spoon' prints as typographic digital downloads; a physical poster with recipe-card styling is different.
'Made With Love Means I Licked the Spoon' is a popular variant; this poster takes a recipe-step approach instead.
Physical 'lick the spoon' prints are rare; most competitors sell digital files at $2-$6.
Amazon baking posters focus on conversion charts, retro housewife imagery, and cat-baker puns.
Recipe-card style posters are uncommon on Amazon; most results are metal tin signs or wooden plaques.

research.notes: Picked 'lick the spoon poster' because the phrase 'lick the spoon' appears in multiple Etsy listings and the poster literally ends with that line. 'Spoon poster' is an indexed Etsy market page. The recipe-card format differentiates from competitor typographic prints.
